research_rationale:
EO 7814 (signed 1938-02-15, 3 FR 447) is a one-time land action: it revokes EO 4430 of April 23, 1926, as modified, "as to the following-described public land" (Fourth Principal Meridian, T. 32 N., R. 9 W., sec. 9, lot 1, .50 of an acre). The dossier's single clause covered the neighboring National Wild Life Week proclamation text (characters 0-2585), not the order, so the inventory is corrected to the order's operative text at characters 2990-3475 of the held Federal Register page. The revocation is self-executing ("is hereby revoked") and was performed when the order was signed on 1938-02-15; it is a completed act, not a continuing duty (completion_of_task). The first end rests on the order's own self-executing terms; a later instrument revoking the parent order is not relied on because its source page was not verified, and no held instrument names EO 7814 itself.
